netcdf cdf5types-cdf5 {
dimensions:
	n = 3 ;
variables:
	ubyte ub(n) ;
	ushort us(n) ;
	uint ui(n) ;
	int64 i64(n) ;
	uint64 u64(n) ;
data:

 ub = 0, 128, 255 ;

 us = 0, 32768, 65534 ;

 ui = 0, 2147483648, 4294967294 ;

 i64 = -9223372036854775807, 0, 9223372036854775807 ;

 u64 = 0, 9223372036854775808, 18446744073709551615 ;
}
